title: access.bootstrap, contract version 1
description: The one-time access bootstrap (PRD 5.10, 5.16) in one changeset: the bootstrap role, created with role.create's plan unless a role has its id, and its grant to a staff actor on a node, allowing in every locale, with grant.assign's plan. It is a maintenance command on no surface: cms:access:bootstrap runs it as the installation operator. A handle another role has, a role with the id whose ceiling or permissions are not these, and an actor that is not an active staff or service actor are validation_failed, and a grant whose id exists is version_conflict. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Maintenance\Domain\Commands\GrantBootstrapRole, and the generated codec GrantBootstrapRoleCodecV1 reads it and writes its canonical JSON: every key, sorted, no whitespace.

grant.description: The new grant's id, which the caller makes.

actor.description: The id of the staff actor to get the bootstrap role.

node.description: The id of the node the grant holds on, with the subtree below it.

role.description: The bootstrap role's id: a new id, which the caller makes, or the id of the role with the handle that is the bootstrap role already.

handle.description: The bootstrap role's handle, cbox-cms.access.bootstrap_role: a lowercase letter followed by up to 62 lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

ceiling.description: The highest classification the role's holders read through it, from public to sensitive.

permissions.description: The command and query names of the registry the role may run, each once; cms:actions lists them.

permission.description: The name of a command or query without its version, such as entry.create: lowercase segments in snake_case joined by dots, at least two.
